newsitem.title: UK: First Direct boss moves to Citibank.
newsitem.headline: First Direct boss moves to Citibank.

text.p: Britain's Midland Bank, part of the HSBC group, said on Wednesday that the chief executive of its telephone bank First Direct was leaving for a job at Citibank in the United States.
Midland said Kevin Newman was leaving after eight years to take on "a senior position" at Citibank in New York.

It said Graham Picken, currently First Direct's chairman, would take on a broader executive role at the bank as well as his responsibilities as chief executive of Forward Trust Group -- Midland's finance and leasing arm.
And Andrew Armishaw, director of information technology at First Direct, will take up the new role of chief operating officer with responsibility for "all aspects of customer service and operations".
Picken said Newman had joined First Direct "at the outset in January 1989 and played a crucial role in developing the business". "We will be sorry to see him go," he added.
